summary: Ứng dụng web mã nguồn mở cho theo dõi giá cổ phiếu thời thực, cảnh báo cá nhân và khám phá insights về công ty, hoàn toàn miễn phí và xây dựng openly.
usecases: Track real-time stock prices with customizable alerts for individual investment strategies.
Provide open-access financial data for researchers and developers building market tools.
Serve as a free alternative to costly proprietary market platforms.
ideas: Integrate AI sentiment analysis from financial news to enhance alert relevance.
Extend as a PWA with mobile-friendly interface for on-the-go monitoring.
Connect with decentralized finance dashboards for hybrid traditional/crypto insights.
